name: nft-public-mint
description: CLI sniper for public SeaDrop NFT mints — builds calldata on-chain, no OpenSea token required

scripts.vault-setup: npm run build --silent && node dist/vault-cli.js setup
scripts.vault-status: npm run build --silent && node dist/vault-cli.js status
scripts.vault-list: npm run build --silent && node dist/vault-cli.js list
scripts.vault-clear: npm run build --silent && node dist/vault-cli.js clear
